```{r}
library(tidyr)

G_ = read.csv(file = "../data/example_data_G.csv",header=TRUE)
F_ = read.csv(file = "../data/example_data_F.csv",header=TRUE)
E_ = read.csv(file = "../data/example_data_E.csv", header=TRUE)
X_ = read.csv(file = "../data/example_data_X.csv", header=TRUE)

N <- nrow(G_[,-1])
M <- ncol(X_[,-1])
P <- ncol(G_[,-1])
t <- G_[,1]
t <- (t - t[1])/(1e9)/3600
#t<- diff(t)
X_ <- X_[,-1]
E_ <- E_[,-1]
F_ <- F_[,-1]
G_ <- G_[,-1]
F_ <- apply(F_, MARGIN=2, FUN = as.numeric)
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
plot(G_[,1], type="l")
plot(G_[,2], type="l")
plot(G_[,3], type="l")
plot(F_[1,], type="l")
plot(F_[2,], type="l")
plot(F_[3,], type="l")
```


```{r}
source("../R/bernstein.R")
```

```{r}
O <- N
t <- (t - min(t))/(max(t)- min(t))
B <- t(bernstein.matrix(O,t,a=0,b=1))
D <- t(bernstein.derivative.operator(O))
concentration <- 1* rep(1,M)
C <- diag(N) -  (1/N)*matrix(data=rep(1,N*N), nrow=N, ncol = N) 
S <- diag(apply(X_,MARGIN =2,FUN=sd))
B <- mrbsizeR::dctMatrix(N)

library(cmdstanr)
set_cmdstan_path("~/cmdstan")
file = "../models/curve_analysis.stan"

mod <- cmdstan_model(file)


data_list <- list(N=N, M=M , P=P, Xv=scale(X_,center=T,scale = T), sigma=E_, timesteps=t, minerr=
    min((E_)) / 10, O = O, B= B, D=D, T =length(t), MAX=100, concentration=concentration, F=F_, C=C, S=S)
fit_bamf <- mod$sample(
  data = data_list, 
  #seed = 123, 
  chains = 4, 
  parallel_chains = 4,
  refresh = 500 # print update every 500 iters
)
```


```{r,max.height='100px'}
library(posterior)
stan_fit <- rstan::read_stan_csv(fit_bamf$output_files())
temp = rstan::extract(stan_fit)
length(temp$G[,1,1])
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)
quick_diagnostic_plots <- function(stan_fit){
  stan_fit$diagnostic_summary()
  stan_fit$cmdstan_diagnose()
  mcmc_rhat(rhat(fit_bamf))
  mcmc_neff(neff_ratio(fit_bamf))
  draws <- stan_fit$draws(format="df")
  G_1 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^G\\[\\d+,1'))
  G_2 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^G\\[\\d+,2'))
  G_3 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^G\\[\\d+,3'))
  DG_1 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^DG\\[\\d+,1'))
  DG_2 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^DG\\[\\d+,2'))
  DG_3 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^DG\\[\\d+,3'))
  F_1 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^F\\[1,\\d'))
  F_2 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^F\\[2,\\d'))
  F_3 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^F\\[3,\\d'))
  A_1 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^A\\[\\d+,1'))
  A_2 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^A\\[\\d+,2'))
  A_3 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('^A\\[\\d+,3'))
  G1_mean <- G_1 %>% colMeans()
  G2_mean <- G_2 %>% colMeans()
  G3_mean <- G_3 %>% colMeans()
  DG1_mean <- DG_1 %>% colMeans()
  DG2_mean <- DG_2 %>% colMeans()
  DG3_mean <- DG_3 %>% colMeans()
  A1_mean <- A_1 %>% colMeans()
  A2_mean <- A_2 %>% colMeans()
  A3_mean <- A_3 %>% colMeans()
  F1_mean <- F_1 %>% colMeans()
  F2_mean <- F_2 %>% colMeans()
  F3_mean <- F_3 %>% colMeans()
  G1_sd <- G_1 %>% as.matrix() %>% matrixStats::colSds()
  G2_sd <- G_2 %>% as.matrix() %>% matrixStats::colSds()
  G3_sd <- G_3 %>% as.matrix() %>% matrixStats::colSds()
  F1_sd <- F_1 %>% as.matrix() %>% matrixStats::colSds()
  F2_sd <- F_2 %>% as.matrix() %>% matrixStats::colSds()
  F3_sd <- F_3 %>% as.matrix() %>% matrixStats::colSds()
  par(mfrow=c(2,3)) 
  plot(G1_mean, type ="l")
  plot(G2_mean, type ="l")
  plot(G3_mean, type ="l")
  plot(F1_mean, type ="l")
  plot(F2_mean, type ="l")
  plot(F3_mean, type ="l")
  dev.off()
  par(mfrow=c(2,3)) 
  plot(A1_mean, type ="l")
  plot(A2_mean, type ="l")
  plot(A3_mean, type ="l")
  plot(DG1_mean, type ="l")
  plot(DG2_mean, type ="l")
  plot(DG3_mean, type ="l")
  dev.off()
  corrplot(cor(cbind(G1_mean,G2_mean,G3_mean),G_))
  dev.off()
 
  par(mfrow=c(2,3))
  plot(G_[,1],G1_mean)
  plot(G_[,2],G2_mean)
  plot(G_[,3],G3_mean)
  plot(F_[1,],F1_mean)
  plot(F_[2,],F2_mean)
  plot(F_[3,],F3_mean)
  dev.off()
  par(mfrow=c(2,3))
  plot((G_[,1]-G1_mean)/G1_sd)
  abline(h=2)
  abline(h=-2)
  plot((G_[,2]-G2_mean)/G2_sd)
  abline(h=2)
  abline(h=-2)
  plot((G_[,3]-G3_mean)/G3_sd)
  abline(h=2)
  abline(h=-2)
  plot((F_[1,]-F1_mean)/F1_sd)
  abline(h=2)
  abline(h=-2)
  plot((F_[2,]-F2_mean)/F2_sd)
  abline(h=2)
  abline(h=-2)
  plot((F_[3,]-F3_mean)/F3_sd)
  abline(h=2)
  abline(h=-2)
  dev.off()
  lst(G1_mean, G2_mean, G3_mean, F1_mean, F2_mean, F3_mean)
}

  plot((G_[,3]-G3_mean)/G3_sd)
  abline(h=2)
  abline(h=-2)
  dev.off()
  
}


quick_diagnostic_plots_MAP<- function(stan_fit){
  draws <- stan_fit$draws(format="df")
  G_1 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,1'))
  G_2 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,2'))
  G_3 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,3'))
  F_1 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('F\\[1,\\d'))
  F_2 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('F\\[2,\\d'))
  F_3 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('F\\[3,\\d'))
  G1_mean <- G_1 %>% as.matrix()
  G2_mean <- G_2 %>% as.matrix()
  G3_mean <- G_3%>% as.matrix()
   F1_mean <- F_1%>% as.matrix()
  F2_mean <- F_2 %>% as.matrix()
  F3_mean <- F_3 %>% as.matrix()
  par(mfrow=c(2,3)) 
  plot(t(G1_mean),type="l")
  plot(t(G2_mean),type="l")
  plot(t(G3_mean),type="l")
  plot(t(F1_mean),type="l")
  plot(t(F2_mean),type="l")
  plot(t(F3_mean),type="l")
  dev.off()
  corrplot(cor(cbind(t(G1_mean),t(G2_mean),t(G3_mean)),G_))
  dev.off()
  corrplot(cor(cbind(t(G1_mean),t(G2_mean),t(G3_mean))))
  dev.off()
  par(mfrow=c(2,3))
  plot(G_[,1],t(G1_mean))
  plot(G_[,2],t(G2_mean))
  plot(G_[,3],t(G3_mean))
  plot(F_[1,],t(F1_mean))
  plot(F_[2,],t(F2_mean))
  plot(F_[3,],t(F3_mean))
  dev.off()
  lst(G1_mean, G2_mean, G3_mean, F1_mean, F2_mean, F3_mean)
}

diagnostics <- quick_diagnostic_plots(fit_bamf)
